sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Twitch NY 2026 case (Rare) (Twitch 2026) is a Event Reward Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A case with some rare goodies.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
